result_text: Both tooltips now HTML-escape the repository name, so `acme "shop"` shows as plain text and no markup reaches the page. I only compiled the `reports` module (it builds cleanly). I didn't run any tests or generate a report to look at the output. The change is in `LandscapeReportGenerator.java`: - **Language blocks:** in `addLangInfo(NumericMetric)`, the name is wrapped in `StringEscapeUtils.escapeHtml4`. This covers the main, test and other code variants, since they share that method. - **Size table:** in the "Repositories Size Distribution" section, the repository name is escaped the same way. - **Import:** I added `org.apache.commons.text.StringEscapeUtils`, which is already used elsewhere in `reports`. I escaped at those two call sites rather than in `startDivWithLabel`, because that method is shared by many other tooltips. Counts, lines of code, order and layout are unchanged.
